adversarial_review.incomplete_access: Frame probes use first/middle/last and claim-specific positions, not every frame. BitRobot and VLABench pointer cases inspect the selected loader table but do not run training. FineART and droid cannot complete dataset construction for independent schema reasons.
adversarial_review.revision_drift: Every recovered path was fetched at a 40-character commit and SHA-256 hashed. Frozen info/stats and available LFS hashes were checked. No latest-branch data were substituted.
adversarial_review.selection_bias: All eleven unresolved findings in the four named checks were included; no case removed because of unavailable per-dataset pages or difficult loaders. The previously confirmed r413:c2:f2 is excluded by the frozen unresolved filter.
adversarial_review.shared_assumptions: The verifier imports no kinema detector code. It uses upstream LeRobot releases, raw parquet/MP4 and the frozen audit only to identify assertions and pins. A direct decoder probe cannot replace full dataset iteration.
adversarial_review.weak_labels: No policy checkpoint is specified for four inference-normalization claims. Those remain unresolved despite successful raw frame loading in three cases. No training or real-world miss-rate claim is made.
